title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-burst-util-reporting-policy-refactor
author: Jordan Lee
description: Motivation: Improve Dedicated fleet autoscaler behavior for priority-based routing and burst token-bucket controls while concurrently tightening utilization reporting. This PR refactors the autoscaler policy layer to separate priority routing, burst budgeting, and utilization aggregation, enabling clearer SLAs and smoother burst smoothing. Changes include: 1) introduce PriorityPolicy interface and concrete implementations for PerTenantPriority and WeightedPriority routing, 2) token-bucket refactor to allow configurable burst windows and smoothing factors per-priority, 3) accurate utilization reporting by computing cluster-level and per-priority rolling-window metrics with backpressure signals exported to observability, 4) add e2e and unit tests covering edge cases (priority inversion, burst exhaustion, and fallback to best-effort), 5) update metrics and logging to include new labels (priority_level, burst_state) and new dashboards. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-2345) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests in perf-canary - [x] Metrics and dashboards updated - [x] Backwards-compatible config parsing (v1/v2) - [x] Release notes prepared Rollout plan: staged rollout to Dedicated fleets behind feature flag autoscaler.priority_refactor with gradual ramp and realtime monitoring of queueing latency and burst utilization. If regressions observed, feature flag will be rolled back and fallback deployed. Related: ENG-2345 (design), SUP-4123 (customer incident that motivated improved burst transparency).
